aboutText: With over 15 years of dedicated audio visual experience, the team at Wired Store has been Melbourne's go-to specialists for home theatre setups, commercial displays, and smart home integration. We proudly serve suburbs right across Melbourne, delivering tailored AV solutions that perfectly match each client's space, lifestyle and budget. Our certified installers combine technical expertise with genuine passion for every project, ensuring flawless results backed by comprehensive after-sales support and industry-leading warranties on all products and workmanship.

servicesText: From home theatre design to large-scale commercial AV rollouts, we provide end-to-end audio visual solutions across Melbourne. Every project includes expert consultation, professional installation, and comprehensive after-sales support with full product warranty coverage.

services.title: Home Theatre & Projectors
services.desc: We supply and expertly install premium projectors, fixed and motorised screens, and complete home theatre packages tailored to your dedicated cinema room or living space.

services.title: Sound Systems & Audio

services.title: Video Conferencing

services.title: Smart Home & Security
